title: Reduction of relative multisymplectic manifolds
summary: We extend the multisymplectic reduction theory of Blacker -- itself the extension of Marsden--Weinstein--Meyer reduction to $k$-plectic manifolds -- to the setting of \emph{relative} multisymplectic geometry, in which a smooth map $F\colon M\to N$ carries a closed nondegenerate relative $(k{+}1)$-form $\varpi=(ω,η)$ in the mapping-cone complex of $F$.
